qt: to the Commission Balázs Orbán (PfE), Sebastian Tynkkynen (ECR), Ondřej Knotek (PfE), Milan Uhrík (ESN), Petras Gražulis (ESN), Barbara Bonte (PfE), Tom Vandendriessche (PfE), György Hölvényi (PfE), Zsuzsanna Borvendég (ESN), Fernand Kartheiser (NI), Virginie Joron (PfE), Gerald Hauser (PfE), Alvise Pérez (NI), António Tânger Corrêa (PfE), Tobiasz Bocheński (ECR), Gheorghe Piperea (ECR), Diana Iovanovici Şoşoacă (NI), Branko Grims (NI), Kateřina Konečná (PfE) Subject:

The Commission regularly conducts, commissions and finances public opinion surveys, including through the Eurobarometer. These surveys examine EU citizens’ views on the EU, its institutions and its policies and priorities. Given that the President of the Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, holds one of the EU’s most prominent institutional positions, we have the following questions. 1.

Since 1 December 2019, has the Commission conducted, commissioned or financed any public opinion poll, survey or public opinion analysis measuring EU citizens’ recognition and perception of, trust in, support for or disapproval of Ursula von der Leyen?
If so, which surveys were conducted, when were they carried out, what questions were asked, what results were obtained at EU level and by Member State, and where can these results be accessed?

If no such survey has been conducted, why not? Has the Commission considered assessing public perceptions of Ursula von der Leyen personally, and what criteria does it use to determine which EU institutions and senior officeholders are covered by the public opinion research it conducts, commissions or finances?
